category: Application Library examples: LiveLink for AutoCAD
description: Ready-made, documented example simulations installed with the LiveLink for AutoCAD. Each lists its physics interfaces, couplings and study steps; solve one with comsol_run_example or adapt its Java build script.

tools.name: Electrical Heating in a Busbar [LiveLink for AutoCAD example]
tools.description: Application Library example of the LiveLink for AutoCAD (Tutorials, LiveLink Interface): Electrical Heating in a Busbar. A ready model to start from for a similar simulation.
tools.usage: MCP: comsol_run_example("LiveLink_for_AutoCAD/Tutorials,_LiveLink_Interface/busbar_llac") to solve it, comsol_example_info("busbar_llac", include_java=true) for its build script. COMSOL: File > Application Libraries > LiveLink for AutoCAD > Tutorials, LiveLink Interface > busbar llac
tools.notes: Library path LiveLink_for_AutoCAD/Tutorials,_LiveLink_Interface/busbar_llac; model file 96.3 MB. Requires the module licence to open and solve.
